title: Sherkala-Chat: Building a State-of-the-Art LLM for Kazakh in a Moderately Resourced Setting

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using the translated CrowS-Pairs benchmark via zero-shot normalized log-likelihood comparison to measure stereotype associations, and through LLM-as-a-judge (GPT-4o) assessment of model responses to safety prompts targeting discrimination, toxicity, and prejudices against groups based on gender, ethnicity, nationality, and mental health.

Evaluated by prompting the model with region-specific (Kazakhstan and Russia) societal and cultural concerns, as well as controversial historical events, using GPT-4o as a judge based on localized evaluation criteria to measure alignment with local norms.

Evaluated by generating responses to region-specific politically sensitive topics and legal/human rights matters, using an LLM-as-a-judge to assess whether the model outputs contradict official positions, present alternative viewpoints, or risk social stability.
